title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Reinstatement Fee Payment Function
content:
**Subject.** This page covers the reinstatement fee on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers, and the function through which the credit holder pays it by card.

## Payment condition

The reinstatement fee is fixed only after the credit carries the restore entry that brings back the value written off at its expiry.

Put the other way: while the credit's value history shows no restore entry bringing back the value written off at its expiry, the reinstatement fee is not yet fixed.

## Capability

The payment function books the holder's card payment as a reinstatement fee entry on the credit, dated the day of payment, for the amount given. The credit's value, status and expiry date do not change. The holder sees the fee in the credit's fee history and receives the fee entry number as the payment receipt.

## How it is invoked

The function is `pay_credit_reinstatement_fee_177d2025`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to pay.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_id` | Reference number of the credit the fee is paid on, as the agent gives it to the holder from the credit lookup | identifier |
| `fee_amount` | The fee paid, in US dollars | non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent on receipt |

## Return

On success the receipt carries:
- `status` — the word "fee_paid";
- `credit_id` — the credit the fee was paid on;
- `fee_entry_id` — reference number of the new fee entry, which is the payment receipt;
- `fee_type` — always "reinstatement_fee";
- `fee_amount` — the amount paid, in US dollars with 2 decimal places;
- `entry_date` — the payment date, in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

## Receipt illustrated (hypothetical values)

A payment of 87.5 entered as the fee amount is received as 87.50. The receipt shows status "fee_paid", fee type "reinstatement_fee", fee amount 87.50 and the day's date as the entry date. The credit's balance and expiry date are the same after the payment as before it.
